discription: A resonant pulse wave synthesizer with LFO-modulated pulse width, creating a dynamic, evolving timbre.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, lfoFreq=5, lfoDepth=0.4, filterCutoff=8000, filterResonance=0.1;    var sig, env, lfo;    env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    lfo = LFSin.kr(lfoFreq).range(0.1, 0.9);    sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth + (lfo * lfoDepth)) * env;    sig = RLPF.ar(sig, filterCutoff, filterResonance);    Out.ar(out, sig * amp ! 2);}
